# routeros_ip_cloud_back_to_home_file_settings (Resource)




<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `prefer_relay_code` (String) Relay code that will be preferred for the File share connection. If it is not set, the relay with the smallest RTT is chosen. The available relay codes are listed by `/ip/cloud/print`.

### Read-Only

- `certificate` (String) Certificate used by the File share service. Maintained by the service, it cannot be set.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the File share service is currently running. Turned on by the service itself as soon as a share exists, it cannot be set.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
